steps.content:
02:13, December 2, N.F. 114
MBCC Chief's Office
Happy moments are always fleeting. After victory comes the arduous task of sifting through intelligence reports.
Fortunately, you're not alone in working overtime.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: They're not prioritizing the West District. We can probably rule out the chances of them being from Nirvana, or those looking to get a piece of Nirvana's pie.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: They have ties to both the FAC and the Outlands. Hmm... not many clues here, but let's make a note of it.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: They were aware of shackles but not their sensing ability, which led to their defeat during the kidnapping. So it can't be any MBCC moles, or personnel from the 9th Agency and FAC.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Plus, there's that private club and the arrested negotiators. We might uncover something unexpected from these leads.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: What about the satellite towns? When you brought them up, two of them in particular looked conspicuous.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You're right. Okay, now that's plenty of leads here to keep the 9th Agency occupied for a while. The agents were pretty happy, saying our operation was a great success.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: That's great. You've done very well, Chief.
Perhaps out of habit from her time with Elvira, Jelena reaches out as if to pat your head.
You instinctively draw back. Jelena realizes her gesture might be inappropriate, her hand frozen in mid-air. The moment lingers between you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It was all thanks to your help with the preparations the night before. The information you shared all proved effective in probing them, also putting me in the right mindset about how far they could go.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: There's just this one thing I've been curious about...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: During our previous sessions in the interrogation room, you never brought any of this up. Why the sudden change of mind?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You also mentioned that the Prime Minister never shared his work with you. So, where did all this information come from?

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: Let's just say I wasn't entirely truthful before. After seeing how dependable and trustworthy you were that night, I decided to share all the intel I'd been withholding.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: See? I truly do trust you now.

You are eager to delve deeper, particularly about the origins of her intelligence, but just then, the office door creaks open slightly. A figure peeks through the doorframe, eyes fixed on both of you.
Elvira seems less timid now, her eyes carrying a hint of silent reproach.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: Yesterday, you whisked me away while Sable was in training. El has been quite unsettled by it.

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: ...Jelena, it's bedtime.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: Mmm... Actually, I...
Found you.
Another figure peeks out from the doorframe—it's Hecate, whose sudden appearance startles Elvira.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: You agreed to the synchronization training. The first body double op only succeeded because no one there knew you. Information about you will spread, and our luck may not hold out then.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Come with me, let's optimize the next operation plan.
Elvira appears clearly reluctant.

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: I don't want to...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: This is scheduled. I asked and you agreed. And don't disturb Chief at work.
Despite their shared youth and delicate frames, it's evident that Elvira is no match for an A-Class Sinner. In the end, she's gently lifted away by Nightmare invisible to her.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Hecate just isn't good with words. She's actually very gentle.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: Hehe, I think they’ll get along well. Hecate is so calm and quiet, which helps El feel less anxious around her. This way, she can gradually learn to cope with the outside world.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: She cannot remain by my side forever. Engaging with peers her age is a precious opportunity. I simply wish she could make some friends.
Jelena watches the lively departure of the two with a gentle smile playing across her face.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You hope Elvira can make friends, and live a happier life here?
She comes back to herself, considers what you said, and responds with nothing more than a gentle smile.
The situation is far from optimistic. Your brief moments of finding light in dark times must end now—it's time to get serious again.

Urban attacks persist despite a decrease, driven by Puppets inciting Mania among crowds. The 9th Agency has dismantled several hidden sorcery installations, but these were all pre-planted traps—the mastermind behind it all unknown to us.

At this point, they have finally begun exhibiting traces of the familiar Underground style. However, this development strikes you as too deliberate, almost as if the enemy is purposely toying with you all.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: ...Do you intend to delve deeper?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Nothing is certain until we catch the real culprit behind the cabinet attack.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Besides... While we've managed to lure out a group after Elvira, they're not exactly what I expected. Those who would ally with the Underground, assassinate the councilors so brutally, and attack the mansion—they'd never be willing to sit down for a talk.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Looks like the Prime Minister's position draws a lot of hate, and there's no shortage of people who want to get rid of you two all along with him. I'll have to check them one by one.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: The threat has diminished. No one's in jeopardy, and the culprit has been cautioned. They are unlikely to act again.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: But if you press on, they may think of it as a declaration of war. What do you think they would do then?

options: Even better if they dare to make a move.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That would save me the trouble of tracking them down. I'll be waiting.
Your words draw a bitter chuckle from her.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: You're still hiding your wound from your adjutant, aren't you? If she knew they dared to harm you, she would never endorse this plan.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: Next time, it won't be a mere trivial injury.
Having noticed genuine concern cross her face, you quickly drop your solemn demeanor and opt for a light-hearted tone.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Is this how a top-notch butler behaves professionally? Don't worry about me—just focus on Elvira. I'll manage just fine, Jelena.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: You made a promise to protect El. It wouldn't be responsible for you to walk away now, right?
Ah... That familiar sense of overprotection.

Your adjutant, colleagues, and even Hecate sometimes act this way—almost everyone who cares about you does. But eventually, they can only yield to your persistence. After all, you're the Chief, and there will always be times when you must step forward.

However, Jelena stands apart. Talk of duty is merely her method of convincing others. Your rank holds no significance to her—she only wants to keep you safe, as if you are still just a child in her eyes.
But in the end, you are not Elvira.

options: Thank you for trusting me as one of your own.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But if a few scratches could scare me off, I'd have no right to talk big about protecting you all. Look—
You roll up your sleeve to show the scars on your arm.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm not that fragile. I'm not just a chief; I'm also a fighter, trusted by my comrades in action. Experience has taught me that the more perilous the situation, the less space there is for hesitation, especially when you want to protect something.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm not sure what this new era of peace may look like, but from the past I know, anyone seeking something has to be ready to fight for it.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Sure, most of the time you only see me taking cover behind Sinners. But I've also taken bullets in the West District, right here—
You point to a spot on your body with a grin.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm a tough one to kill, so don't worry. You can put more trust in me.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Even if things go south, I'll have contingency plans ready for all of you.
She remains silent for a long while, her bowed head veiling her emotions.
She raises her hand and gently touches your supposed "bullet wound," where you randomly pointed to, her fingers brushing against your shirt.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: ...Here?
Well... actually... it's not.

Even though the scars remain, you haven't given them much thought in a long time, so much so that you've forgotten their precise locations. When questioned unexpectedly, your previous assurance wavers.
...Maybe it's the guilt of telling a little white lie catching up to you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Caught a bullet, spent half a year in recovery, then bounced right back.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: During your time in Eastside, you might have seen many councilors living their pampered lives. But I'm different—I'm younger, and much more thick-skinned.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: You’ve suffered more injuries than the ones I can see, haven’t you?

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: ...Where else?

...You find yourself at a loss for words. No one has ever asked about your scars with such genuine concern before. After all, you are the <color=#fb9259>Chief</color> everyone looks up to, always dependable and tough.
But in Jelena's eyes, you are something else entirely.
As if grasping your pretense, she refrains from further inquiries. Her gaze lowers as her fingertips trail across your shirt, softly skimming over scars that even you yourself had forgotten.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: Had these wounds taken a slightly different turn, Chief, you might not have been here today.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...But I pulled through. I don't regret stepping onto the battlefield. Without these scars, I wouldn't be who I am today.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: We all run into obstacles that seem impossible to overcome. Believing you can evade them at all times is just wishful thinking of a child. When there's no way to retreat, you grit your teeth and press on... And maybe that's just what makes you grow up in the end.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: There's a young girl once told me that what doesn't kill her makes her stronger—guess that's what I'm getting at. She's also a tough one, even more so than I am.

Jelena listens in silence, her gaze fixed on you. A peculiar, unfamiliar sensation washes over you as those lake-blue eyes seem to melt away your barriers, leaving you frail and exposed, almost as if—
You quickly catch yourself.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I mean, you can trust more in Elvira too. She is really something special.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I think she went to practice shooting alone in the training room so that you wouldn't have to worry anymore. Perhaps it was also her way of protecting you—back then, you were so visibly anxious that you couldn't even hide it.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: From such a young age, she has already learned to cherish her loved ones, and she's willing to find her courage for all of you. One day, she'll grow up to be someone strong, strong enough to make you proud.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Have a little more faith in her, too.
Jelena remains silent. Instead, her fingers gravitate towards your recent wound. The injury still raw, your body instinctively tenses—a reaction that doesn't escape her notice.
She offers you a faint, strained smile and decides to follow your change of subject.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: I'm aware of how resilient she is.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: But even the strongest people still feel pain when they're hurt.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: Watching her endure all of that, seeing her tears of pain run dry... Even though I know she’ll make it and grow stronger, part of me still longs for a reality where none of this had to happen.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: If the journey to growth means walking such a painful path... I'd rather she stay an innocent child forever, never having to grow up.

Recognizing the naivety in her words, she shakes her head with a self-deprecating smile. After finishing bandaging your wound and adjusting your coat with a few gentle pats, she asks in a casual tone, as if attempting to change the subject.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: Wouldn't your parents feel the same way?
Your attempt to evade the question comes too late, and as you finally gather your thoughts to respond, the words catch in your throat.
Jelena takes in every detail of your reaction.
She fixates on you, her gaze unwavering, as the unfathomable haze in her eyes finally clears. What remains are depths of sorrow in her blue eyes, profound as deep waters.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: ...I see... You've been through a lot...
She extends her arms slowly, pulling you into her embrace.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...I'm not a child anymore.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: Mm, I know...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Elvira will also grow up just fine. There's a bright life awaiting her ahead, because she is surrounded by people working hard to protect her.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Both you and I will protect her.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: I know...

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: Thank you...
[Dark Web - Shadow Protocol 2]
- The agents have already traced their way to me, all thanks to the failure last time. Being kind-hearted really doesn't pay off in the end.

- Looks like it's about time to teach them a lesson. That candidate is just a nobody; should be a breeze to handle. Just pave the path for Cavendish. - But the other one... He's backed by someone in Paradeisos.
steps.female_content: - Looks like it's about time to teach them a lesson. That candidate is just a nobody; should be a breeze to handle. Just pave the path for Cavendish. - But the other one... She's backed by someone in Paradeisos.

steps.content: - It's fine. There's no Black Ring anymore, he's not as crucial now. As long as someone takes the fall, Paradeisos won't make a fuss. They'll eventually come to terms with it, as they always do. - No need to go overboard, though. A simple warning will do. We act before the next gathering, agreed?

steps.speaker: News
steps.content: The electoral landscape shifts again as December Surprises unfold, with a new revelation from the Judicial Inspection Bureau.

steps.speaker: News
steps.content: Max King, one of the election candidates, is embroiled in campaign finance irregularities. Compelling evidence and witness accounts point to questionable funding origins, with allegations of illegal fundraising from the Outlands.

steps.speaker: News
steps.content: The Prosecutor's Office has initiated legal action, with the Acting Chief of the Outland Affairs Bureau detained by the 9th Agency for further investigation.

steps.speaker: News
steps.content: The upcoming election holds critical significance for DisCity's security. With just over two decades of independence from Outland interference, the recent reintegration of the West District highlights the urgent need for heightened vigilance against potential Outland infiltration.

steps.speaker: News
steps.content: In response to these potential charges, Max King's campaign office is actively engaging in legal protocols, denouncing them as a targeted smear campaign orchestrated by their rival. Nevertheless, this legal battle is poised to significantly impact the election dynamics.

steps.speaker: News
steps.content: Meanwhile, Councilor Cavendish's approval ratings are on the upswing. The Stewart family has verified that the MBCC Chief gained access to their estate through an invitation from Cavendish, and their collaborative intelligence efforts effectively thwarted the second large-scale attack during this election season.

steps.speaker: News
steps.content: This news, combined with Max King's recent statements, has sparked further discussions online. Public trust in Councilor Cavendish has seen a general increase...
[Cavendish Residence]

steps.speaker: Bernadette
steps.content: Things must be quite dire on your end. What made you come here instead of focusing on your allies during this pivotal time?

steps.speaker: Bernadette
steps.content: Or, do you no longer have an ally, Mr. King?
